{{Quote|I got a deal for a whole shipload of these pit droids&hellip; maybe too many, but in the race arena you never know.|Watto|<ref name="Pit Droids" />}}
A '''freighter''' delivered the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto's]] largest shipment of [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droids]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] leading up to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The [[Transport/Legends|transport]] unloaded its cargo at the [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], but not before sustaining significant damage at the hands of Watto's new [[Droid/Legends|droids]] despite the use of [[launcher]] devices aboard to store them. While the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] had a [[Color/Legends|white]]-colored [[Hull/Legends|hull]] that covered its upper section, the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] bore an exposed belly from which varying apparatus protruded.

==Description==
Equipped with [[Engine/Legends|engine units]] at the rear, the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] sported [[Color/Legends|gold]] and black markings on its white, bulbous upper [[Hull/Legends|hull]]. "TCHJEGR" was written on the starboard side of the hull in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]]. At the ventral section of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was an assortment of protruding apparatus. Serving as a [[Transport/Legends|transport]], the ship was loaded with [[launcher]]s, devices which stored multiple [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|DUM-series pit droids]] in their folded and deactivated state. The vessel had a gray interior that contained crates and [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] tanks.<ref name="Pit Droids" />

==History==
[[File:Pitdroidstack_wsmi.jpg|thumb|right|120px|The freighter transported pit droid mechanics.]]
Within the [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] leading up to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news19990721.html|text=The Pit Droids are Coming!}} states that the [[freighter]] made its delivery of [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|pit droids]] during [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] employment under [[Watto/Legends|Watto]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that Skywalker left Watto in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] at the age of nine, Skywalker must have been first employed within the ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to 32 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. Therefore, the freighter made its delivery of pit [[Droid/Legends|droids]] within the [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] leading up to that year.</ref> the freighter was hired by the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] to ferry numerous DUM-series pit [[Droid/Legends|droids]] contained in launchers to [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], a [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Because of the DUM-series [[Maintenance droid/Legends|droid mechanics']] value in [[Mos Espa Circuit]]'s [[Podracing/Legends|podraces]], Watto's business interest was piqued, resulting in the transport's cargo amounting to the largest shipment of pit droids the junk [[Merchant/Legends|dealer]] had ever purchased.<ref name="Pit Droids" />

However, as the transport ship landed on Tatooine, the pit droids had already inflicted more damage in waiting idly aboard than even Watto's star [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], could possibly repair.<ref name="Coming">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news19990721.html|text=The Pit Droids are Coming!}}</ref> The freighter also held such a large quantity of pit droids that they threatened to overrun Mos Espa, necessitating Watto to hire an [[Unidentified contractor (Watto)|individual]] to assist in coordinating his new droids as they made their way from the ship to the city's podrace circuit.<ref name="Pit Droids" />

==Behind the scenes==
The freighter was first mentioned in an article published on [[StarWars.com]] on [[July 21]], [[1999]]. The article announced the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Pit Droids]]'',<ref name="Coming" /> which was released by [[Lucas Learning]] in [[September 13]] of that year<ref name="LLPR">{{WebCite|url=http://www.lucaslearning.com/press/press_archive_pitdroids.htm|text=LUCAS LEARNING® RELEASES STAR WARS® PIT DROIDS® - A GALAXY FULL OF MIND-BENDING LOGIC GAMES|work=[[Lucas Learning]]|archivedate=20111117210548}}</ref> and featured the ship. The transport ship's interior is the setting for the first of nine stages of the game.<ref name="Pit Droids" />
